full_prompt_en: This is a square, textured cinematic illustration of a weathered cowboy aiming a revolver toward the viewer against a fiery red background. The man fills most of the frame from the chest upward. A broad dark hat cuts across the upper edge, its brim casting a heavy shadow over narrowed eyes. Gray hair shows at the temples, and a coarse pale beard frames his mouth and jaw. His brow is deeply furrowed, giving the face a strained, determined expression. One arm thrusts forward from the lower left; his hand wraps around the revolver, and its dark barrel faces out near the center of the picture. The foreshortened hand and metal cylinder appear larger than the shoulder behind them, pulling the action into the viewer's space. A dark reddish coat forms angular folds across the lower right, where scratchy black lines reveal the drawing beneath the paint. The background is a broad red-orange field with rough vertical scuffs and uneven patches of deeper crimson. Warm light from the left catches the cheek, knuckles, and parts of the gun, while the hat, eye sockets, and coat folds hold dense brown-black shadow. Brush marks, rubbed pigment, and ink-like crosshatching remain visible across skin, cloth, and background; nothing looks photographically smooth. The edges of the hand and weapon are clear enough to anchor the focal point, while the torso partly dissolves into the red ground. No lettering is visible. The overall composition is confrontational and compressed, with a dark diagonal gesture cutting through a hot, distressed color field.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、有粗粝肌理的电影式插画，一名饱经风霜的牛仔在火红背景前朝观者瞄准左轮手枪。男子从胸部以上占据画面大部分区域。宽大的深色帽子横切上边缘，帽檐在眯起的双眼上投下浓影。太阳穴旁露出灰发，粗糙的浅色胡须围住嘴和下颌。眉头深锁，使面部显得紧绷而坚定。一只手臂从左下向前伸出，手掌握紧左轮手枪，深色枪口在画面中央附近朝外。透视缩短的手与金属转轮比后方肩膀显得更大，把动作拉进观者所在的空间。深红色外套在右下形成棱角衣褶，刮擦般的黑线显露出颜料下面的素描感。背景是一大片红橙色，带有粗糙竖向擦痕和深绯红不均匀斑块。从左侧来的暖光照到脸颊、指节和部分枪身，帽子、眼窝与衣褶则保留浓厚褐黑阴影。笔痕、擦磨的颜料和墨线般的交叉排线遍布皮肤、布料与背景，没有一处像照片般平滑。手与武器的边缘足够清晰，支撑焦点，躯干却部分融入红色底面。画中没有文字。整体构图具有迎面逼来的压缩感，一道深色斜向动作切穿灼热而斑驳的色域。
style_prompt_en: The illustration combines poster-like cinematic framing with rough paint, scraped pigment, and ink-dark hatching. Hot red, burnt orange, umber, and near-black occupy broad interlocking areas, while limited pale highlights bring a few planes forward. Strong foreshortening and diagonal thrust create immediacy; large cropped forms press close to the frame instead of receding into a wide setting. Edges sharpen around the main gesture and break apart into strokes elsewhere, so the image feels both legible and visibly handmade. Side lighting cuts under dark overhangs, producing angular pockets of shadow and hard-won highlights. Vertical scuffs in the ground counter the directional central form. The overall treatment is gritty, forceful, and graphic, with surface wear reinforcing the compressed drama.
style_prompt_zh: 这种插画将海报般的电影取景与粗糙颜料、刮擦色层和墨黑排线结合。炽红、焦橙、深褐与近黑组成宽大的交错区域，有限的浅色高光让少数平面向前突出。强烈的透视缩短与斜向冲势带来直接感；大块被裁切的形体紧贴画框，而非退入宽阔场景。主要动作周围的边缘清楚，其他地方则碎成笔触，因此图像既容易辨识，又保留明显手工痕迹。侧光从深色遮盖下切入，形成棱角状暗穴与来之不易的高光。底面的竖向擦痕与中央的方向性形体相抵。整体处理粗砺、有力且图形化，表面磨损强化紧凑戏剧性。
